'''Polith''' was the [[Star/Legends|primary]] of the [[Polith system]], also known as the Thyferra system, in the [[Jaso sector/Legends|Jaso sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Most notable of its six orbiting [[Planet/Legends|planets]] was the [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]-producing world of [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].
